description: This file contains utility functions for comparison operations (Equal, NotEqual, Less, LessEqual, Greater, GreaterEqual) used in the Go 'text/template' package, including type reflection and error handling.

methods.name: basicKind
methods.description: Determines the basic kind of a reflect.Value (e.g., bool, int, uint, float, complex, string) or returns an error if the type is unsupported.

methods.name: Equal
methods.description: Evaluates whether the first argument is equal to any of the subsequent arguments, supporting various basic types.

methods.name: NotEqual
methods.description: Evaluates whether the first argument is not equal to the second argument.

methods.name: Less
methods.description: Checks if the first argument is less than the second argument, supporting numeric and string types.

methods.name: LessEqual
methods.description: Checks if the first argument is less than or equal to the second argument.

methods.name: Greater
methods.description: Checks if the first argument is greater than the second argument.

methods.name: GreaterEqual
methods.description: Checks if the first argument is greater than or equal to the second argument.
